name: Beard maxxing

lead: Beard maxxing means growing, trimming or enhancing facial hair to change how the lower face looks. The appearance payoff is a framed jaw, a stronger-looking chin and added masculinity; forum users call it one of the cheapest and most visible looksmaxes and discuss styles for different jaw shapes.

The chain is direct: a beard adds a hair outline to the jaw and chin, which changes how the lower face reads. Beard growth is driven by androgens such as DHT and by genetics. Research cited by Wikipedia suggests bearded faces are rated as more dominant, while findings on attractiveness are mixed.

paras: Most people grow the beard out over weeks, then shape the neckline and cheek line and keep it trimmed to suit their jaw. For sparse or patchy growth, topical minoxidil (studied in one placebo-controlled trial) and beard hair transplants are discussed. The change is visible as the beard fills in.
Grooming carries minor risks such as ingrown hairs; pseudofolliculitis barbae is a documented shaving-related condition. Beard transplants are surgery with the usual procedural risks.

angle.text: You grow and shape a beard to frame the jaw, disguise a recessed chin or add masculinity, and the change shows as the beard fills in. Minoxidil or transplants are sometimes used for patchy growth. Research on how beards affect attractiveness has produced mixed results.

lead: Beard maxxing is the looksmaxxing practice of growing, shaping or enhancing facial hair to change how the lower face and jawline appear. Community members describe a beard as one of the cheapest and most visible changes a man can make, and discuss styles aimed at framing the jaw, disguising a weak chin or short ramus, or adding perceived masculinity.

Beard growth is driven by androgens, mainly dihydrotestosterone, and is partly genetic [1]. Methods discussed in the community range from grooming and styling to topical minoxidil and, in medical practice, beard hair transplantation. Evidence on how beards affect attractiveness is mixed and the wiki records both what proponents and what researchers report.
infobox: Shaving reverses it; transplant is surgical

paras: Beard maxxing covers keeping stubble or a full beard, choosing a shape that complements face structure, and trying to improve patchy growth. Forum users discuss beard styles for particular facial structures, for example a thread on styles for a short ramus.

Wikipedia describes beards as secondary sexual characteristics, stimulated by DHT, with growth rate partly genetic [1]. Their fashion history is cyclical: Hadrian was reportedly the first Roman emperor to wear a full beard, Peter the Great ordered Russian men to shave in 1698 and taxed beards in 1705, and beards surged in mid-19th-century Europe before declining in the early 1900s and returning briefly in the late 1960s [1].

sections.h: Effects on appearance and research views
paras: According to Wikipedia, clean-shaven faces are rated less dominant than bearded ones, facial hair appears to influence male attractiveness, and scholars disagree whether beards evolved mainly through attractiveness or dominance signalling [1]. The article does not report specific studies of how women rate beards [1].

Reviews describe growing demand for facial hair transplantation, using follicular units, usually taken from the scalp, to fill sparse areas of the beard. Beard reconstruction techniques are also described in trichology literature. A randomized, double-masked, placebo-controlled study of minoxidil 3% lotion for beard enhancement was published in the Journal of Dermatology in 2016; minoxidil's mechanism in hair is not fully understood, according to a review.

Shaving-related skin conditions are a documented concern: pseudofolliculitis barbae is a chronic inflammatory condition from attempts to remove beard hair, reported to affect up to one in five Caucasian individuals in some studies and much more commonly black individuals.

A randomized, double-masked, placebo-controlled study examined 3% minoxidil lotion for beard enhancement. Hair-transplant literature on beard reconstruction consists mainly of technique reviews. No studies were found testing beard styling specifically for jawline appearance.

lore.intro: Beard maxxing is a frequent topic on looksmax.org, with opinion divided on whether beards enhance or conceal facial structure.

claims.claim: A beard is among the easiest, cheapest big looksmaxes
